title: HideArmor
description: Hide your armor easily and switch between showing and hiding it whenever you want
body:
HideArmor toggles armor visibility without removing equipped gear.
Players keep their armor and stats, while choosing to hide or show all pieces or specific slots.

Commands:
```
/hidearmor
/hidearmor reload
/hidearmor hide <head|chest|legs|feet|all>
/hidearmor unhide <head|chest|legs|feet|all>
```
